model.note: Part outlines are traced from Kobelco's photo of the SK35SR-7 with cab and are approximate. The engine, filters, hydraulic tank, cooling pack and battery are hidden and listed. The Kobelco operator's manual was not online: the OM link is Yanmar's TNV engine manual, and machine items are best practice. Serial PX18020917 falls in the SK35SR-7 run, but confirm the model and the engine (3TNV88F or 3TNV82A-B) on the plates before ordering engine filters.

upper.name: Upper structure: engine hood and counterweight
upper.desc: Rear hood over the engine, radiator and oil cooler, with the counterweight at the back. Daily: engine oil, coolant and fuel levels; clean the radiator and oil cooler fins and the iNDr intake screen; check the fan belt.

cab.name: Cab and operator station
cab.desc: Daily: lights, horn, travel alarm, seat belt and the quick-hitch locking pin. The photo shows the cab version: check whether Excavator 1 has a cab or a canopy.

boom.name: Boom and boom hoses
boom.desc: Grease the bucket, arm and boom pins, the swing post and the blade pivots every 8-10 h (best practice; taskTracker greasing templates 30808 and 30812 are duplicates with no interval, so they never come due).

boomcyl.name: Boom cylinder
boomcyl.desc: Grease the bucket, arm and boom pins, the swing post and the blade pivots every 8-10 h (best practice; taskTracker greasing templates 30808 and 30812 are duplicates with no interval, so they never come due).

armcyl.name: Arm cylinder
armcyl.desc: Grease the bucket, arm and boom pins, the swing post and the blade pivots every 8-10 h (best practice; taskTracker greasing templates 30808 and 30812 are duplicates with no interval, so they never come due).

arm.name: Arm (dipper)
arm.desc: Grease the bucket, arm and boom pins, the swing post and the blade pivots every 8-10 h (best practice; taskTracker greasing templates 30808 and 30812 are duplicates with no interval, so they never come due).

bucketcyl.name: Bucket cylinder
bucketcyl.desc: Grease the bucket, arm and boom pins, the swing post and the blade pivots every 8-10 h (best practice; taskTracker greasing templates 30808 and 30812 are duplicates with no interval, so they never come due).

link.name: Bucket linkage
link.desc: Grease the bucket, arm and boom pins, the swing post and the blade pivots every 8-10 h (best practice; taskTracker greasing templates 30808 and 30812 are duplicates with no interval, so they never come due). Check the quick-hitch locking pin daily if a hitch is fitted.

bucket.name: Bucket and teeth
bucket.desc: Grease the bucket pins every 8-10 h (best practice). Bucket teeth: Notion's V13SYL (Esco-style) is unverified, so match the fitted adaptors before ordering.

blade.name: Dozer blade
blade.desc: Grease the blade pivots every 8-10 h (best practice).

light.name: Boom work light
light.desc: Check the lights, horn and travel alarm daily.

swing.name: Swing bracket, swing bearing and slew ring
swing.desc: Grease the swing post pins every 8-10 h (best practice). Grease the swing bearing and slew ring pinion every 50 h and check the swing gear grease at 250 h (best practice: confirm in the Kobelco manual).

track.name: Rubber tracks and undercarriage
track.desc: 300 mm pads (the SK35SR-7 listing shows 11.8 in): measure width x pitch x links before ordering a pair. Daily: tension, cuts, debris, and leaks at the sprockets, idlers and rollers. Check track tension every 50 h. The tracks have no grease points apart from the tensioner.

engine.name: Engine: Yanmar 3TNV88F (check the plate)
engine.desc: US SK35SR-7: Yanmar 3TNV88F, 3-cylinder about 1.6 L, 24.4 hp gross. The SK35SR-6E sold elsewhere has a Yanmar 3TNV82A-B: read the engine plate before ordering engine filters. Oil API CF or higher (CD/CF/CF-4/CI-4), ACEA E-3/E-4/E-5 or JASO DH-1, SAE 15W-40 or 10W-30; capacity not found (Notion's 8-12 L is unverified). Yanmar: oil and filter every 500 h or yearly unless the Kobelco manual says otherwise (keep 250 h if it does). 250 h: check engine speed control and fan belt (first check at 50 h). 1000 h: valve clearance (dealer). 1500 h: injectors, EGR cooler, crankcase breather (dealer).

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Change with the oil every 500 h or yearly. Kobelco number not found. Notion's YM129150-35151 / VA11900-35154 are from Yanmar's larger 4TNV family: do not order them unconfirmed. Get the number from Kobelco AU by serial PX18020917.

fuel.name: Fuel tank, filter and water separator
fuel.desc: Tank 42 L diesel (SK35SR-7 US listing 11.1 gal; SK35SR-6E brochure 42.0 L). Daily: check the separator for water; drain it every 50 h. Every 500 h or yearly: replace the fuel filter element, clean the separator and drain the tank sediment. Club stock holds Yanmar 129A00-55800 (consistent with a TNV fuel filter, fit not confirmed); Notion lists YM129470-55700: confirm which fits. Replace fuel and cooling hoses every 2000 h or 2 years.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Clean the element every 250 h and replace it every 500 h. Kobelco numbers not found: Notion's YN11P00029S003 / S004 are 'typical SK series' guesses and unverified.

hydraulics.name: Hydraulic tank, return and pilot filters
hydraulics.desc: SK35SR-6E brochure: tank 20.4 L, system 44.8 L (not confirmed for the -7). Oil per the Kobelco manual (ISO VG46 AW is typical but unverified). Check the sight gauge daily with the bucket curled in and the arm vertical as on the decal. Return and pilot filter intervals (1000 h listed) and numbers are to be confirmed with Kobelco; Notion's YN52V01025R100 looks like a larger-excavator part.

cooling.name: Radiator, oil cooler and fan belt
cooling.desc: Clean the radiator and oil cooler fins and the iNDr intake screen daily; check and clean the radiator fins at 250 h. Coolant spec and capacity not confirmed. Drain, flush and refill every 2000 h or 2 years and replace the cooling system hoses.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: Check the battery at the 250 h service.

service.name: Service records and warranty
service.desc: taskTracker: 250 h template 33115 has no tasks or parts; 500 h template 35574 has a blank interval, so it may never trigger (set it to 500 h). WO 1434 (minor service) was done 5 Oct 2026 but is still open (MCH-6). If this is a 2024 SK35SR-7 it may still be under Kobelco warranty (US listing 4 years / 4000 h; AU terms not checked): keep dealer service records. The Kobelco operator's manual was not online: engine items follow the Yanmar TNV manual, machine items are best practice until checked against the chart in the cab.

travel.name: Travel motor and reduction gear
travel.desc: Check the travel reduction gear oil levels at 250 h (best practice). Oil change interval, spec and capacity not confirmed: check the Kobelco manual (listed for 1000 h).

YM129470-55700.name: Fuel filter (Notion's number)
YM129470-55700.note: Notion's primary fuel filter number. Club stock holds 129A00-55800: confirm which fits before ordering.
